NIGHT_THREATS: Numbers triple after dark and they gain darkvision.
At night the parasites take over and they coordinate like a single organism.
Dormant by day; at night they hunt in packs led by a Level +5 alpha.
Sunset triggers a frenzy; they attack anything, including each other.
After dark they go quiet and stalk. You won't hear them.
At night they retreat to nests and the region's real predator comes out (roll a second mob).
They light fires at night. Follow the glow only if you want a fight.
Night doubles their level and halves their loot.
RUIN_FEATURES: A signpost pointing to the nearest settlement. Half the signs lie.
A crashed circus wagon, cages open.
A public restroom that still works. Guarded by nothing. Suspicious.
An abandoned shrine to an Old God; offerings still fresh.
A fog bank that never lifts. Minimap goes dark inside it.
A collapsed bridge; the detour adds hours.
A crawler graveyard with names carved in three scripts.
A working fountain. The water is fine. Probably.
A gallows with a fresh notice: crimes and the crawler executed for them.
Ruined guildhall; the training dummies still animate.
A carnival calliope playing slowly, somewhere in the fog.
A rooftop route that avoids the streets, if you can climb.
A river crossing with a ferryman who takes payment in stories.
A field of standing stones, warm to the touch.
A watchtower, intact, manned by something that waves back.
An orchard still fruiting, the ground beneath it picked clean.
A caravan circled for the night, fires cold, nobody inside the ring.
A rope bridge over a gorge, one plank in three missing.
A hot spring that heals slowly and attracts everything within a mile.
A toppled statue of something the locals still leave food for.
A beehive the size of a cottage, humming in time with something.
A dry riverbed full of bones, sorted by size.
A hunter's blind overlooking a game trail that is still in use.
A boundary wall running for miles with no gate and no corner.
A grove where nothing grows but the trees, and the trees lean inward.
A mill with the wheel still turning and no water in the race.
A sinkhole with stairs cut into its wall, going down.
A roadside gibbet, the cage empty, the lock cut from the inside.
A plague marker fencing off a village that looks fine from here.
A trapper's line of snares, all sprung, all empty.
A quarry flooded to the brim, the equipment still on its shelf.
A shepherd's hut stocked for one person for a year.
A canopy walkway strung between trees, maintained by somebody.
A clearing with a single chair in the middle of it, facing the trail.
A termite mound taller than a house, carved with doors.
A salt flat that rings underfoot and holds a footprint for a week.
A stand of trees felled in one direction, all at once.
An aqueduct carrying clean water somewhere nobody has found.
A pilgrim's rest with a visitor's book and no recent entries.
A dead god's footprint, filled with rain and fish.
A boundary of hung charms the local mobs will not cross.
A burnt-out camp, fire pit still warm, tracks leading nowhere.
A tree with doors in it, each opening onto the same room.
A sunken road, banks higher than a man, perfect for an ambush.
A marsh with a causeway of stepping stones, one of them a back.
A vineyard gone to rot, the press full, the smell carrying for miles.
An obelisk listing names, adding one as you watch.
A ranger station with a map wall and every route crossed out but one.
